messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [PROD] pager triggered — auth-service (privnet-west1) reporting sustained 401/403 spike (~1200r/s) and increased log-forwarding to metrics pipeline. Pager: @anna_sre oncall.

anna_sre: I see the spike and an unusual pattern in the logstream: headers showing duplicated auth headers + a raw token prefix in the payload. Linking a small sample to the private bucket (s3://redwood-incidents/6088887777/sample-headers.txt). Can infra pause the metrics logdrain?

mike_auth: digging in — confirmed. The staging → metrics forwarder appears to be including `X-Client-Token` in the forwarded payload for a subset of requests from a specific backend pool. Sample (sanitized):

```
GET /v1/embeddings 200
Host: metrics.internal
X-Client-Token: svc-abc12345***
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
```

That `svc-abc1...` looks like a rotated service token, not a user token. It should never be in metrics payloads.

anna_sre: @infra-bot please run `logdrain pause metrics-forwarder privnet-west1` and confirm. Also set a temporary denylist for the originating pool IPs and throttle ingestion. We need to stop further exfil first.

infra-bot: Command accepted: `logdrain pause metrics-forwarder privnet-west1`. Throttle rule applied: `denylist-6088887777` added for IPs 10.34.12.0/28.

tess_sec: tagging in — what's the exposure scope? Any customer PII in the samples? If tokens only, we still need rotation + evidence preservation. Recommend immediate rotation of any service tokens found in logs and a short customer-impact review. Also we should determine whether this is a misconfiguration or intentional leakage.

mike_auth: quick scan of the sample set: no free-text user PII. Only internal service tokens and request ids. Pattern: tokens emitted when a debug flag on the backend pool was enabled and the forwarder appended headers for debugging. That debug flag was enabled in a hotfix two hours ago. So likely misconfig.

anna_sre: ACTIONS (short):
- Pause metrics forwarder (done).
- Revoke/rotate all service tokens that match prefix `svc-abc` (mike -> auth).
- Block offending pool IPs + retain logs for forensics (infra).
- Notify legal + security, preserve evidence (tess, @legal_jane).
- Run quick audit for other forwarders with debug flags (anna -> infra).
- Postmortem + followup to remove debug-hotfix path from prod (eng).

eng-lead-rob: Any user/customer impact? Are customer API calls failing?

mike_auth: No customer-facing errors observed; auth latency and throughput steady. This is a telemetry leak — the metrics pipeline may lose some batched points while paused. If we rotate tokens quickly and re-enable after sanitization, customer-facing impact should be minimal.

legal_jane: Please preserve the full original logfiles (not sanitized) in the secure evidence bucket and record chain-of-custody. We may need to notify customers if we find tokens tied to customer-managed integrations. Also include a short timeline and who executed the pause/rotations.

anna_sre: Noted. @infra-bot archive logs to s3://evidence/6088887777-raw and lock access to SRE + Security + Legal.

infra-bot: Archive completed, ACLs set (SRE, Security, Legal).

mike_auth: Starting token rotation now: revoking `svc-abc*` prefix tokens and issuing replacements. ETA 12 minutes. I'll post when complete and list replacement token ids (sanitized).

anna_sre: I'll stay on until rotation completes then hand off to next oncall. Next steps after rotation: run automated checks for debug flag presence across all environments and add a pre-commit check to prevent forwarding secret headers.

tess_sec: Also recommend an immediate temporary rule: drop `X-Client-Token` from any outbound logdrain payloads at the forwarder level regardless of debug flags. We'll deploy a pod-level filter.

eng-lead-rob: Good. Please include an exec summary for customers if Legal advises notification. Keep the comms conservative until we have final scope.

anna_sre: HANDOFF: @mike_auth will monitor token rotation + re-enable sanitized forwarder; @tess_sec and @legal_jane will own evidence and notification assessment. I'll update the incident channel when rotation completes and then hand the remaining cleanup to the next SRE oncall (shift change in ~40m).

mike_auth: Rotation complete. Replacements issued (sanitized ids): `svc-rpl-xxxx` and `svc-rpl-yyyy`. Re-enabled metrics-forwarder in sanitized mode (drops `X-Client-Token`). Monitoring for errors.

anna_sre: Verified no new 401 spike post-rotation. Metrics backlog processing restarting. Moving to post-incident followup. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
